edges.reason: Circle/arc construction produces geometric drawings; education instrument mapping independently reinforces manufacturer geometry-set placement.
Compas is used for mathematical geometric constructions; national mathematics remediation explicitly uses compass and ruler for an angle bisector.
Manufacturer Math Set includes both ruler and compass; the label promises co-use in a set, not a synonym or necessary ingredient.
Echer constructs geometric lines/angles; national teaching material explicitly maps it to inclined lines and names ruler/echer for geometric decoration.
Right-angle/set-square work is geometric mathematics; the national teaching material places it among geometric drawing instruments.
Manufacturer geometry set includes ruler and set squares, supporting the exact co-use label.
Raportor constructs/measures angles in geometric figures; national mathematics guidance explicitly names this use.
National mathematics remediation explicitly names rapportor for geometric figures and angle measurement.
Manufacturer geometry set includes ruler and protractor; mathematics guidance also combines them for bisectors.
Maped Study universal-holder compass explicitly accepts a normal pencil or pen. The limited some-models label avoids asserting every compass holds a full pencil.
Vileda describes brooms collecting fine dust and particles on floor surfaces; cleaning direction is correct.
Broom sweeps debris into the dustpan; sweeps_into describes that directed role instead of a symmetric co-use key.
Dustpan collects debris swept by the broom; collects_from describes the complementary direction, not a duplicate symmetric relation.
DEX identifies Taburet as a small backless seat; subtype-to-Scaun direction is correct and no reverse is-a edge appears.
Specialized piano stool is a seat for piano playing; the some-models label avoids claiming every stool has this purpose.
Piano may be played from a stool; played_from is the complementary direction and preserves the qualified reading.
Tefal catalogue and actual Unlimited cratiță product specify stovetop heat-source compatibility; vessel is heated on the cooker.
The cooker heats the vessel. Complementary direction is true; it does not assert a material or ingredient relation.
Dictionary explicitly defines a kitchen cooking vessel; used_in direction to Bucătărie is appropriate.
Tefal Quick Chef indexed primary recipe text places soup vegetables and broth in a cratiță and boils them. The may-cook label is truthful.
The same soup recipe explicitly uses this vessel; may-be-prepared-in is a qualified independently readable reverse relation.
Dairy-industry primary handbook explicitly separates and standardizes milk cream for whipping. Milk is the raw source; this is not an instruction that ordinary milk whips directly.
Romanian Oetker instructions whip cold sweet cream into Frișcă; source and finished-product owners are distinct.
The same manufacturer instructions explicitly use a mixer; the may-be-prepared-with wording allows other whipping methods.
Manufacturer preparation adds powdered sugar; the optional sweetened-with wording does not make all whipping cream pre-sweetened.
STAEDTLER Math Set includes compass and set squares together; one directed co-use edge adds this real same-kit neighbor.
STAEDTLER geometry set includes protractor and set squares together; one directed co-use edge supports the same kit.
Vileda mopping instructions explicitly remove dry dirt by sweeping before the wet mop step. The direction follows that sequence.
Vileda offers broom OR vacuum for removing dry floor dirt. The label limits equivalence to that job; this is not a universal capability or noun synonym.
DLRLC explicitly places low stools before an armchair as foot supports; qualified low-model reading avoids universal function.
DLRLC explicitly places low stools before a sofa as foot supports; this second seating context is directly stated by the source.
Tefal Ingenio instructions explicitly permit suitable cookware on the hob and in the oven. Only compatible models are claimed.

The original Diplomat recipe lists liquid whipping cream and explains its aeration into the dessert cream. This exact qualified ingredient belongs to the cake. It is a factual ingredient association, not a complete one-pair recipe or permission to promote a trivial board.

sense_limits: Compas means the drawing instrument here, not a navigation compass.
Raportor means the angle-measuring instrument here, not a reporting person; raportoare is the neuter plural.
Taburet includes a primary seat and specialized piano-seat/footstool uses; the board uses the primary seating sense.
Mătură means the cleaning tool; accent-insensitive input also accepts the identical-looking verb form.
Cratiță is a distinct low-sided cooking vessel, not imported as an alias for Oală.
No hidden Contexto round is proposed for these new nodes.
Smântână remains the existing fermented sour-cream owner. The new qualified whipping cream never owns bare smântână, smântână dulce, or ready-whipped Frișcă.
Removing de8676 corrects the old false fermented-cream-to-Frișcă relation. The new cream→Frișcă link names its correct nonfermented source.

The redundant Echer→Riglă used_together reciprocal is omitted. Sweeps_into/collects_from and seat_for/played_from encode distinct directional roles already stated by their labels; they are not symmetric aliases.
Mătură also has botanical senses; board context selects the common cleaning-tool meaning.
limits: This accepts graph proposal bytes only. Board critique, prospective eligibility, six-game impact and full integration remain separate gates.
The added cream→Diplomat edge truthfully models an ingredient but may create a one-pair shortcut for some seed sets; raw Diplomat round has therefore been held rather than weakening this fact.
Prior exact source observations for unchanged nodes/edges were retained; changed relations, new links, new cream node/forms and removal received fresh review.
Salience and strength are editorial parameters, not measured frequencies. No hidden Contexto targets or human playtesting are approved.
Some manufacturer pages were verified via indexed primary-source passages due direct-fetch limitations; those access limits are recorded per source.
